expirationRisk: Some original GitHub Artifacts expire around2026-11-28; preserve and restore the same bytes, never regenerate by rerunning old suites
restoreBoundary: Download the saved TAR through its authorized archive provider; verify TAR SHA256, then original ZIP identity/digest/CRC. Pass the original ZIP directory to the existing read-only preparation script. Missing or mismatched originals fail closed.

publicMetadataProjection.archiveLookup: Resolve the exact owner-held archive filename and verify its published SHA256; private access identifiers are retained in the owner delivery.
